description: North Central Province - The Education Statute No. 2 of 1990 of the North Central Provincial Council
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of the "Education Statute No. 02 of 1990" which establishes the legal framework for educational administration in the North Central Province. It contains statutory provisions, regulations, and legal authorities for establishing educational departments and committees, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
